### Key Takeaways

::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
#### Do This in Production

- ✅ Use `uv` for all Python projects
- ✅ Use `with_structured_output()` over free-form JSON
- ✅ Always version and test your prompts
- ✅ Enable LangSmith tracing from day one
- ✅ Use XML delimiters to prevent prompt injection
- ✅ Apply defense-in-depth security (input + output validation)
- ✅ Ground LLM answers in context to prevent hallucination
- ✅ Plan for human-in-the-loop for high-impact actions
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
#### Avoid These Mistakes

- ❌ Hardcoding API keys
- ❌ Using `from langchain_core.pydantic_v1 import ...`
- ❌ Trusting LLM output without validation
- ❌ Skipping LangSmith in development
- ❌ Using the most expensive model for everything
- ❌ Re-embedding documents on every app restart
- ❌ Giving agents unrestricted tool access
- ❌ Skipping security review for customer-facing apps
:::
:::
